scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.audit:prod: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix backend audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && npm --prefix backend test
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e && npm run audit:prod
scripts.preview: npm run build && cross-env SERVE_FRONTEND=true npm --prefix backend start
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production SERVE_FRONTEND=true npm --prefix backend start
